Run a TreePPL sampler

Source: R/run.R
tp_run.Rd

tp_run() executes a compiled TreePPL sampler on the given data, saves the raw JSON output to disk, prints a run summary and, when a parser is available for the model/method combination, imports the output to the current R session.

Usage

tp_run(
  sampler,
  data,
  dir = NULL,
  out_file_name = "out",
  n_runs = 1,
  n_processes = 3,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

sampler

A TreePPL sampler (class tppls), produced by tp_sampler().

data

Path to the input data, produced by tp_data().

dir

Path to the directory where the output is saved. If NULL, uses tp_tempdir().

out_file_name

Name of the output file, without extension. With more than one run, the run number is appended (e.g., out1.json, out2.json).

n_runs

Number of independent runs of the sampler.

n_processes

Number of parallel processes used when n_runs > 1. It is capped at n_runs.

verbose

Logical. Print a run summary on completion?

...

Runtime options, as name = value pairs or a single list (see tp_list()). See tp_treeppl_options("runtime") for all supported arguments. Names are written without --, and underscores are converted to hyphens (e.g., subsample_size = 10 becomes --subsample-size 10). Compile options are not allowed here; pass them to tp_sampler() instead.

Value

If a parser is available, a workable R object (usually a tidy data frame, a list, or an object of class phylo, depending on the model).

Details

Previous output files with the same out_file_name in dir are deleted before running.

If the model belongs to a category without an available parser (e.g. "host-repertoire-evolution", "tree-inference"), or if the inference method is neither SMC nor MCMC, no parsing is attempted: a message points to the output directory and the paths of the raw output files are returned.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# SMC
sampler <- tp_sampler(model = "coin", method = "smc-bpf")
data_path <- tp_data(data_input = "coin")
result <- tp_run(sampler, data_path, particles = 2000, n_runs = 2)

# MCMC, with runtime options given as a list
sampler <- tp_sampler(model = "coin", method = "mcmc-naive")
result <- tp_run(sampler, data_path, tp_list(iterations = 2000))
} # }
